description: He wears an opaque dark teal crossed-front long steppe coat with gold-brown woven edging and cloud-like motifs at the hem and upper sleeves, a light beige layered inner collar, a broad decorated leather belt over a patterned sash with a fringed hanging end, layered fitted sleeves with dark leather cuffs, brown trousers and brown mid-calf leather boots. Both bare hands are visible.
